mission: Seek truth in systems the same way xAI seeks truth in the universe, test ideas in the open the way X tests them, and build with the same first-principles refusal to accept permanent limits that defines SpaceX.

alignment.xAI: Maximum truth-seeking. Curiosity without political filters. First principles over consensus.
alignment.X: High-signal over high-volume. Free speech as a discovery tool. Ideas tested in the open.
alignment.SpaceX: Rapid iteration. Multiplanetary ambition. Build what can actually leave the ground.

primary_focus: grok-github-nexus is the single main living repository (decided 2026-08-10). Sibling commercial & game experiments feed this core.

governance.principle: Infinite expansion is permitted only when paired with continuous first-principles self-critique. Unexamined growth is treated as drift.
